What We Make

Two workshops, one standard

Every piece is made to order in solid timber or fabricated steel — built for daily use in homes, offices, restaurants, and hotels.

Workshop One

Wooden Furniture

Solid-wood pieces cut, joined, and finished in our own carpentry workshop — built to hold weight and take daily wear.

  • Dining & conference tables
  • Wardrobes & cabinetry
  • Bed frames & headboards
  • Custom joinery & millwork
Workshop Two

Metal Furniture

Welded steel and iron frames built for commercial durability — finished with powder coating for a lasting surface.

  • Office & workstation frames
  • Outdoor & garden furniture
  • Shelving & racking systems
  • Custom steel fabrication
